difficulty: one-page product datasheet: full-width coloured title band, two-column grid with prose, a check-mark bullet list drawn by CSS and a callout on the left, and on the right a specification table with group rows spanning both columns plus an ordering table; the table captions are styled like the section headings
title: AquaSense 300
key_sentences: Its sealed probe has no exposed metal electrodes, so readings stay stable for several seasons in acidic or saline soils.
The sensor is installed by pushing it into a pilot hole made with the supplied auger.
A single cable carries both power and data, which keeps installation simple for irrigation contractors and extension officers.
Readings taken closer than this mostly show the wetting pattern of the emitter rather than the moisture of the field.
Several sensors can share one logger, and the logger can send readings to a phone every fifteen minutes.
Volume discounts are available for orders of ten or more sensors.

list_items.text: Measures moisture at three depths along one probe
SDI-12 and Modbus RTU outputs on the same cable
IP68 housing rated for permanent burial
Factory calibration for mineral soils, with a user table for peat

notes: Reading order is the left column (Overview, Features, callout, Typical applications) and then the right column (the two tables and the price note). 'Specifications' and 'Ordering information' are table CAPTIONS styled like headings, not headings. Group rows Measurement / Electrical / Mechanical span both columns and are repeated in both grid cells. Feature bullets are CSS-drawn check marks, so list items carry no marker. Minus signs in '−10' and '−20' are U+2212; '±' and 'µA' are single characters. 'FIELDMARK INSTRUMENTS' in the band is a brand line, not a heading.
